integrity: The infinite statements are proved algebraically. Exact finite replay over all targets through 400000 and three explicit branching levels is supporting evidence, not a substitute for the proof.
scientific limitations: The theorem classifies one-step fibers of the exponent map and proves their cardinalities are unbounded; it does not classify all forward-orbit intersections, minimize targets of a given multiplicity, or modify the validity of the source paper's three-orbit telescoping argument.
title: Exact fibers and unbounded branching of the pentagonal exponent map
